purpose: Repair four verified sizing, reveal and CSS motion issues in the uncommitted generic translation layout work.

scope.baseline: Frozen pre-repair working tree, not Git HEAD

contracts: Only owned layout rules and translation companions may be altered. Page source nodes, identity, ordering, text, current attributes, transfers and deletions must survive restore.

Installed bounded rules must yield to subsequent page-owned inline block sizing, scroll viewports, positioned/chrome/clamped policies. A released policy must not be immediately reinstalled from pending layout work.
Owner-preserving width/typography/content reflow must release the historical expansion floor, keep the measured source floor and settle without perpetual animation-frame polling.
Dimension/overflow changes that reveal previously excluded source must be indexed while watching. Paused sessions retain the existing no-new-collection contract.
CSS transition/animation completion and cancellation must refresh retained typography in document and shadow roots. Owned-companion motion must not loop or override page edits.
No domain rules, API/provider behavior, permissions, source CSS, inline styles or HTML rewriting changes are authorized by these repairs.
validation: Normal collection through fresh Chromium/Firefox artifacts

fixes.implementation: Capture page-owned inline block sizing and priorities; release rules for changed sizing and readable scroll/position/display/clamp policies, and prevent stale pending work from immediately reapplying them. Retain live owners while their policy is overridden, resume only the original policy, and remeasure previously captured footer anchors after the revived containing height settles.
fixes.evidence: Collapsed height about385→0; scrolling region about385→120 in both native engines and both watching states. Paused close/reopen retains the same translation, restores footer placement and keeps one translation request.

fixes.implementation: Visibility mutation detection includes width/height, logical dimensions, min/max dimensions, overflow axes and text indentation while retaining own-write/editor/transform exclusions.
fixes.evidence: Both modes now discover the revealed source and paint one translation without an unrelated class mutation.

fixes.implementation: Shared document/shadow listeners refresh after transition/animation completion and cancellation; own-companion motion is ignored and all listeners dispose with the last reader.
fixes.evidence: White-to-black source motion finishes with matching dark bilingual text without a resize; explicit green companion overrides remain intact.

fixes.implementation: Only installed boxes/owners use one shared ResizeObserver. Reflow relaxes historical floors to the measured source minimum and schedules a separate measured follow-up, preserving the default global-refresh API.
fixes.evidence: Width260→1000 now produces about125px natural height instead of385px, with the same source and target owners.

initialFullFunctional.stage: Initial four-issue repair, before adding paused close/reopen and resumed footer coverage

targetedNative.matrix: 32 bilingual/replace × watching/paused × delivered/deferred restore × finish/cancel CSS motion × Chromium/Firefox cases, plus4 resumed footer cases

functional.scope: All existing layout, lifecycle, dynamic, presentation, review, feed, page and code-boundary browser cases rerun against the final build

sampledPages.engine: Native Chromium; exact packaged content in an isolated world with the existing local MiMo bridge and reused translation cache

metrics.title: React

units.text: The library for web and native user interfaces
React lets you build user interfaces out of individual pieces called components. Create your own React components like , , and . Then combine them into entire screens, pages, and apps.

Whether you work on your own or with thousands of other developers, using React feels the same. It is designed to let you seamlessly combine components written by independent people, teams, and organizations.
Write components with code and markup
React components are JavaScript functions. Want to show some content conditionally? Use an statement. Displaying a list? Try array . Learning React is learning programming.

This markup syntax is called JSX. It is a JavaScript syntax extension popularized by React. Putting JSX markup close to related rendering logic makes React components easy to create, maintain, and delete.
Add interactivity wherever you need it

React components receive data and return what should appear on the screen. You can pass them new data in response to an interaction, like when the user types into an input. React will then update the screen to match the new data.
You don’t have to build your whole page in React. Add React to your existing HTML page, and render interactive React components anywhere on it.

React is a library. It lets you put components together, but it doesn’t prescribe how to do routing and data fetching. To build an entire app with React, we recommend a full-stack React framework like Next.js or React Router .
Things I Learnt from the New React Docs
The ROI of Designing with React
On-device Machine Learning for React Native
Accessible Japanese Form Components with React

React is also an architecture. Frameworks that implement it let you fetch data in asynchronous components that run on the server or even during the build. Read data from a file or a database, and pass it down to your interactive components.
Use the best from every platform

People love web and native apps for different reasons. React lets you build both web apps and native apps using the same skills. It leans upon each platform’s unique strengths to let your interfaces feel just right on every platform.

People expect web app pages to load fast. On the server, React lets you start streaming HTML while you’re still fetching data, progressively filling in the remaining content before any JavaScript code loads. On the client, React can use standard web APIs to keep your UI responsive even in the middle of rendering.

People expect native apps to look and feel like their platform. React Native and Expo let you build apps in React for Android, iOS, and more. They look and feel native because their UIs are truly native. It’s not a web view—your React components render real Android and iOS views provided by the platform.

With React, you can be a web and a native developer. Your team can ship to many platforms without sacrificing the user experience. Your organization can bridge the platform silos, and form teams that own entire features end-to-end.
Upgrade when the future is ready
React approaches changes with care. Every React commit is tested on business-critical surfaces with over a billion users. Over 100,000 React components at Meta help validate every migration strategy.

The React team is always researching how to improve React. Some research takes years to pay off. React has a high bar for taking a research idea into production. Only proven approaches become a part of React.
The React Foundation: A New Home for React Hosted by the Linux Foundation
You’re not alone. Two million developers from all over the world visit the React docs every month. React is something that people and teams can agree on.

This is why React is more than a library, an architecture, or even an ecosystem. React is a community. It’s a place where you can ask for help, find opportunities, and meet new friends. You will meet both developers and designers, beginners and experts, researchers and artists, teachers and students. Our backgrounds may be very different, but React lets us all create user interfaces together.

preexistingObservations: GitHub retains two clipping and one squeeze candidate in visually hidden 1px accessibility-label wrappers; primary before/after candidate geometry agrees. Its latest commit changed between live requests, so the source unit count120→119 is a source-page variation.
Apple retains one offscreen horizontal-carousel clipping candidate in top views; carousel clipping stays intentional.
Shopify retains one narrow sidebar Events/webhooks clipping candidate in bilingual views; no additional clipping appears.
Vue retains two code blocks hidden by its API-style tab choice; translated views match their own source baseline.
React can update one clock text value after initial collection; strict restore preserves the current page value, links and ordering rather than replacing it with the initial snapshot.
limitations: Only eight pages were sampled again in this repair; the earlier70-page audit was not rerun.
Firefox uses native Gecko DOM and fresh packaged content with the existing chrome shim/forced IO; background/popup behavior is covered separately by the existing suite.

Sizing invalidation covers authored inline block-size declarations and readable computed safety policies. Masked height/min-height/grid-row changes from stylesheet-only rules are not inferred by temporarily modifying the page or disabling its styles.
Final CSS motion state is synchronized by end/cancel events. Continuous intermediate animation paint and CSSOM-only changes without observable events are outside this repair.
Paused translation sessions intentionally do not collect newly revealed content; existing retained layout/typography still update.
